Class NitriteQueryBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.model.query.builder.NitriteQueryBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.data.model.query.builder.QueryBuilder
@Internal @Introspected public final class NitriteQueryBuilder extends Object implements io.micronaut.data.model.query.builder.QueryBuilder
Builds Nitrite JSON filter queries from Micronaut Data criteria expressions. Generates JSON that is interpreted at runtime by NitriteFilterBuilder.

Note on explicitly defined queries: This builder and the underlying Nitrite engine explicitly do not support SQL strings. The legacy SQL-parsing support present in older versions (4.14.x) has been entirely removed. Any explicitly defined @Query must use Nitrite's JSON filter syntax.

Since:
5.2.0

    • buildRuntimeFilter

      @Nullable public @Nullable NitriteRuntimeFilter buildRuntimeFilter(@NonNull @NonNull io.micronaut.data.model.query.builder.QueryBuilder.SelectQueryDefinition query)
      Builds the runtime filter directly from a select definition, skipping the JSON serialize/reparse round trip buildSelect(AnnotationMetadata, QueryBuilder.SelectQueryDefinition) needs to satisfy the shared QueryResult contract (a compiled query must survive into generated bytecode as a String; the runtime Criteria path has no such requirement). Mirrors the predicate/projection/order assembly in buildSelect(AnnotationMetadata, QueryBuilder.SelectQueryDefinition).
      Parameters:
      query - the select definition
      Returns:
      the runtime filter, or null if the query needs the aggregation pipeline (joins, group, count) — callers should fall back to buildSelect(AnnotationMetadata, QueryBuilder.SelectQueryDefinition) for that case
